name: Obby But You Lose FPS
desc:
⚠️ Obby contains difficult stages and challenges.

Obby but the further you go, the more FPS you lose. Can you get to the end? There are currently 2 sections with a total of 120 Stages.

💪 At the end of each section, you unlock stable FPS again, so flex on your friends still struggling in low FPS! 

If you enjoy the game, please leave a like and a favorite, it really helps out! Thanks for the support! 😃

Please report any bugs to the group!
